name: CONTACT60
description: CONTACT60 is a benchmark for language-grounded 3D contact prediction. It contains 60 RGB-D scenes (1280x720 images with aligned organised point clouds) and 234 test cases. Each test case pairs a natural-language spatial instruction with a manually annotated binary mask of the image region that satisfies it. A predicted contact point is evaluated by its metric 3D distance to the masked region. The dataset accompanies the paper LaserAttention: Vision-Language Models for Joint Attention in Human-Robot Interaction nd the doctoral thesis of D. Totsila. See the README for the format, how the dataset was built, and its known limitations.
